name: PopupNotifix
author: aziz3d

sections.description:
PopupNotifix is a user friendly and lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to create and display highly customizable popup notifications on your website. It’s an effective tool to grab your visitors’ attention and deliver important messages, promotions, or announcements.

With PopupNotifix, you can:

  • Enable or disable the popup globally.
  • Choose to display the popup on the homepage only or on all pages.
  • Set a delay for the popup to appear after the page loads.
  • Customize the popup’s title, content, and appearance.
  • Embed YouTube videos in your popups.
  • Choose from multiple templates to match your site’s design.
  • Add custom CSS to style the popup to your liking.
  • Select from various animations to make your popup more engaging.
  • Set a custom width and height for your popup.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the popupNotifix folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘PopupNotifix’ settings page to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I create a popup?

You can create and manage popups from the ‘PopupNotifix’ menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.

Can I use a different popup for different pages?

Currently, the plugin displays the same popup on all selected pages (either homepage or all pages).
